milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate close to the hopper and face it, confirming visual identification. The hopper is at spawn-relative position (5, 1, 10) inside the Nether brick room. max_distance=16 allows detection from the room entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the hopper.

Uses inventory_has because mining gilded blackstone causes the block to drop into the player's inventory. With 4 gilded blackstone blocks available and a ~90% per-block chance of dropping itself (vs gold nuggets without Silk Touch), min_count=1 is statistically safe (~99.99% success probability). The diamond pickaxe provided is sufficient for mining.
